note: Diverse media for the restyled landmark works. Entries with mural=true are painted straight onto a wall and render without a frame.

styles.text: Traditional Chinese shuimo ink-wash painting on xuan rice paper: expressive calligraphic brush strokes, graded ink from pale mist to deep black, generous empty space, a few restrained touches of mineral colour, red seal-like accents avoided. Xieyi freehand spirit with poetic atmosphere and an evident paper texture.

Chinese gongbi meticulous painting on aged silk: fine controlled outlines, layered translucent mineral pigments in malachite green, azurite blue, vermilion and shell white, elegant decorative naturalism, patient detail and a soft antique silk tone.

Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print: bold flat colour areas, crisp black keyline, graded bokashi skies, patterned textiles and waves, Prussian blue, persimmon, moss green and cream washi paper grain. Elegant stylized Edo-period print aesthetic.

Japanese Rinpa-style screen painting on shimmering gold leaf: flattened decorative forms, tarashikomi pooled pigment, malachite and ultramarine against a burnished gold ground, refined asymmetry and luxurious stillness.

Indian Mughal miniature painting in opaque watercolour and gold on wasli paper: jewel-toned lapis, emerald, saffron and crimson, exquisitely fine detail, flattened tilted perspective, ornamental floral borders integrated into the image, serene courtly refinement.

Indian Madhubani folk painting: dense double-outlined figures and animals, every surface filled with hatching, dots and floral motifs, natural earth pigments in ochre, indigo, brick red and leaf green on handmade paper, joyful symmetry and narrative charm.

Persian miniature painting: intricately patterned gardens and architecture, luminous turquoise, cobalt, gold and rose, delicate figures with graceful gestures, stacked perspective, illuminated ornamental borders, precious manuscript feel.

styles.mediumZh: 阿拉伯藤蔓紋樣裝飾畫
styles.text: Arabic geometric and arabesque illumination: interlacing star polygons, tessellated tilework and flowing vegetal scrollwork in gold, cobalt, turquoise and ivory, with the subject rendered as stylized silhouettes woven into the pattern. Precise, radiant, meditative ornamental art.

Korean minhwa folk painting on mulberry hanji paper: bold outlines, cheerful flat mineral colours of red, blue, yellow and green, whimsical stylized animals and plants, auspicious decorative composition with naive charm.

Hand-drawn batik on cotton cloth: wax-resist crackle lines, layered indigo, sogan brown and mustard dyes, rhythmic repeating motifs surrounding a clearly readable central scene, visible weave of the fabric.

Byzantine glass and stone mosaic: thousands of small tesserae with visible grout lines, shimmering gold ground, deep blues, terracotta and white marble, hieratic stylized forms, the whole image built from tiles with tiny irregular angles catching light.

Ancient Greek red-figure vase painting: terracotta orange figures reserved against glossy black slip, fine dilute-glaze interior lines, meander and palmette bands, elegant profile poses, the composition presented flat like an unrolled vase frieze.

Mexican folk art painting: exuberant saturated pinks, marigold orange, teal and violet, ornamental patterns of flowers and papel picado shapes, rounded stylized figures with warm humour, hand-painted wooden-panel texture.

styles.mediumZh: 西非織品圖紋壓克力畫
styles.text: Contemporary West African textile-inspired acrylic painting: bold kente-like stripes and wax-print motifs framing simplified confident figures, radiant gold, cobalt, crimson and black, rhythmic geometry and strong graphic impact.

Mid-century geometric abstraction in oil on canvas: hard-edged planes, circles and diagonals in mustard, black, vermilion, slate blue and off-white, balanced tension and rhythm, the subject reduced to its essential shapes while staying recognizable.

Gestural abstract expressionist painting: sweeping loaded brushstrokes, drips and scraped passages in thick acrylic, layered fields of cadmium red, ochre, ivory and ink black, raw canvas edges, emotional energy with the subject emerging from the gestures.

Analytical cubist painting: the subject fractured into overlapping facets seen from several angles at once, muted ochre, umber, grey-green and slate with a few warm accents, sand-textured oil surface, rigorous and rhythmic.

Cut-paper collage: large flat shapes scissored from hand-painted gouache papers in cobalt, coral, lemon, leaf green and black, layered with visible cut edges, paper shadows and glue texture, playful monumental simplicity.

Vintage photomontage collage: torn fragments of sepia photographs, old maps, ledger paper and botanical plates assembled with washi tape and gouache accents, surreal scale shifts, tactile creases and foxing, one clear central idea.

Fabric and thread collage on linen: patchwork of printed cottons, felt, lace and denim, appliqué shapes with visible running stitches and embroidered lines, soft tactile depth, a quilt-like scene with warm domestic colour.
Bauhaus-inspired constructivist screenprint: primary red, yellow and blue with black and cream, diagonal dynamics, circles, bars and photograms, machine-age clarity and elegant asymmetric balance.
Art Nouveau stained-glass window: flowing whiplash lead lines, translucent jewel glass in amber, emerald, violet and rose, backlit glow, stylized botanical curves and a luminous cathedral atmosphere.

Hand-pulled reduction linocut print: bold carved marks, chunky textures and gouged highlights, three or four flat inks in indigo, rust, olive and warm cream, slightly offset registration and honest paper tooth.
Pop art screenprint: halftone dots, flat electric colour blocks in hot pink, cyan, lemon and black, crisp graphic outlines, slightly misregistered layers, witty bold everyday iconography.

Two-colour risograph print: grainy overprinted fluorescent orange and teal soy inks producing a third mixed tone, textured halftones, deliberate misregistration, charming contemporary illustration on uncoated paper.

Vivid spray-paint graffiti mural painted directly on a weathered lime-plaster wall of an old Mediterranean town: soft aerosol gradients, crisp cut-ins, drips, wildstyle energy and neon accents on the sun-bleached plaster, brick and cracks showing through.

Multi-layer stencil street art sprayed straight onto an old stone-and-plaster town wall: crisp cut stencil edges, three or four sprayed tones plus one bright accent, overspray halos, peeling paint and stone texture visible around the image.

Buon fresco painted into wet lime plaster on an old Mediterranean wall: chalky matte earth pigments, sinopia underdrawing traces, giornata seams, softly weathered and partly worn surface, timeless mural dignity.
